candidate_relations.reason: Linear IgA bullous dermatosis requires linear IgA deposition at the basement membrane zone, whereas direct and indirect immunofluorescence showed no IgA and antiplakin IgG antibodies were detected.

Pemphigus foliaceus is associated primarily with desmoglein 1 antibodies and intercellular epidermal staining; both relevant assays were negative, while envoplakin and periplakin antibodies were positive.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct pemphigus subtype targeting desmosomal proteins

candidate_relations.reason: The candidate identifies the same antiplakin antibody-mediated blistering disorder supported by IgG autoantibodies to envoplakin and periplakin.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Equivalent descriptive name for antiplakin dermatosis
